speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE).

The clinical picture of a 31-week infant born to a mother with chorioamnionitis, with low Apgar scores and seizures starting within 72 hours, strongly suggests hypoxic-ischemic injury. I am requesting an MRI of the brain and a serum lactate level to confirm the extent of injury and rule out sepsis.
